author: Admanrayman
quote:
“All sizzle and no steak”.
Bear in mind, 13 years for just average graphics, (for 2026), below average 30fps, and everything else is a chore simulator.. having played all GTA games this is no GTA game. First and last (digital) game I’d ever purchase. Don’t give into the hype. Universal review of 99 seems suspiciously paid for.
